dedupe_keys.name: supplementary documents for water surface evaporation and climate change adaptation using floating solar power plants in iran a case study on asadieh dam

description: Hojjat Borhany publishes processed climate and evaporation inputs, statistical scripts and spreadsheets for a floating-solar study at Asadieh Dam in eastern Iran. Zenodo lists CSV, XLSX and R files under CC BY 4.0 with free public access. The study considers 2025–2050 climate conditions, alternative SSP pathways, Monte Carlo evaporation uncertainty and a proposed 12.6 MWp floating photovoltaic installation. These files can support reservoir-evaporation sensitivity studies or preliminary floating-solar design scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this dam-specific analysis package. The deposit describes processed inputs and tests, not a ready-to-run reservoir operations model. File-level spatial resolution and completeness are not stated in the landing metadata; climate forcing and future emissions assumptions need checking before transfer. No archive or spreadsheet was downloaded, and no evaporation or financial result was recalculated.
